$comment: Single source for the facts the landing publishes (ADR-014 4.2, 5). Values from the e-brochure 2026 and INV 17/10 (ESC-020, FB-INV-002). No room count anywhere (FB-INV-002 point 1). Swap zaloUrl for the verified Zalo OA link with no UI change (US-151 AC2, ESC-021). The email must be a shared mailbox on the OTTIMO domain, never a personal one; leave it empty to hide every email link. facebookUrl is a plain link (no Facebook plugin/SDK – SEC C-1). features.bookingRequest stays false until the booking-request endpoint exists (ARC/BE) and the SEC/legal conditions of US-155 AC4 are met; features.privacyPage turns on the footer link once SEC publishes /privacy/. booking = public promise and windows the page states (BR-912 (4), BR-811, BR-112, BR-305) – the copy is tested against these numbers. paymentReceivingAccountHolder (ESC-008) names the deposit account in the FAQ; empty = sentence without the name (INV 23/10: left empty until INV names the account). legal = operator shown in the footer (INV 22/10, public). checkinTime = earliest check-in when the room is ready, roomReadyBy = the time the room is always ready (BR-401 v0.4.6, FB-INV-004; same idea as the Desk key room_ready_guaranteed_time). roomReadyBy stays out of JSON-LD (no schema.org field); the copy never promises a room ready at checkinTime (banned list). fromNightlyVnd / fromWeekendNightlyVnd = BR-114: change the same day the cheapest direct rate or VAT changes (OWN checks every price change and on the 1st of each month).
